verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֗חַ מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃ נָתָ֣ן הַנָּבִ֑יא בְּֽבוֹא־ אֵ֭לָיו כַּֽאֲשֶׁר־ בָּ֝֗א אֶל־ בַּת־ שָֽׁבַע׃ חָנֵּ֣נִי אֱלֹהִ֣ים כְּחַסְדֶּ֑ךָ כְּרֹ֥ב רַ֝חֲמֶ֗יךָ מְחֵ֣ה פְשָׁעָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: lam·naṣ·ṣê·aḥ miz·mō·wr lə·ḏā·wiḏ nā·ṯān han·nā·ḇî bə·ḇō·w- ’ê·lāw ka·’ă·šer- bā ’el- baṯ- šā·ḇa‘ ḥān·nê·nî ’ĕ·lō·hîm kə·ḥas·de·ḵā kə·rōḇ ra·ḥă·me·ḵā mə·ḥêh p̄ə·šā·‘āy
verses.literal: For the choirmaster A Psalm of David When Nathan the prophet came to him after his adultery with vvv Bathsheba Have mercy on me O God according to Your loving devotion according to Your great compassion blot out my transgressions
Wash me clean . . . of my iniquity and cleanse me from my sin

verses.original: כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֣י אֵדָ֑ע פְ֭שָׁעַי וְחַטָּאתִ֖י תָמִֽיד׃ נֶגְדִּ֣י
verses.literal: For I know my transgressions and my sin is always before me

verses.original: לְךָ֤ לְבַדְּךָ֨׀ חָטָאתִי֮ עָ֫שִׂ֥יתִי וְהָרַ֥ע בְּעֵינֶ֗יךָ לְ֭מַעַן תִּצְדַּ֥ק בְּדָבְרֶ֗ךָ תִּזְכֶּ֥ה בְשָׁפְטֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ḵā lə·ḇad·də·ḵā ḥā·ṭā·ṯî ‘ā·śî·ṯî wə·hā·ra‘ bə·‘ê·ne·ḵā lə·ma·‘an tiṣ·daq bə·ḏā·ḇə·re·ḵā tiz·keh ḇə·šā·p̄ə·ṭe·ḵā
verses.literal: Against You You only have I sinned and done what is evil in Your sight so that You may be proved right when You speak and blameless when You judge

verses.original: הֵן־ חוֹלָ֑לְתִּי בְּעָו֥וֹן וּ֝בְחֵ֗טְא אִמִּֽי׃ יֶֽחֱמַ֥תְנִי
verses.literal: Surely I was brought forth in iniquity I was sinful when my mother conceived me

verses.original: הֵן־ חָפַ֣צְתָּ אֱ֭מֶת בַטֻּח֑וֹת תוֹדִיעֵֽנִי׃ חָכְמָ֥ה וּ֝בְסָתֻ֗ם
verses.transliteration: hên- ḥā·p̄aṣ·tā ’ĕ·meṯ ḇaṭ·ṭu·ḥō·wṯ ṯō·w·ḏî·‘ê·nî ḥāḵ·māh ū·ḇə·sā·ṯum
verses.literal: Surely You desire truth in the inmost being You teach me wisdom in the inmost place

verses.original: תְּחַטְּאֵ֣נִי בְאֵז֣וֹב וְאֶטְהָ֑ר תְּ֝כַבְּסֵ֗נִי אַלְבִּֽין׃ וּמִשֶּׁ֥לֶג
verses.literal: Purify me with hyssop and I will be clean wash me and I will be whiter than snow

verses.original: תַּ֭שְׁמִיעֵנִי שָׂשׂ֣וֹן וְשִׂמְחָ֑ה עֲצָמ֥וֹת דִּכִּֽיתָ׃ תָּ֝גֵ֗לְנָה
verses.literal: Let me hear joy and gladness let the bones You have crushed rejoice

verses.original: הַסְתֵּ֣ר פָּ֭נֶיךָ מֵחֲטָאָ֑י מְחֵֽה׃ וְֽכָל־ עֲוֺ֖נֹתַ֣י
verses.literal: Hide Your face from my sins and blot out all my iniquities

verses.original: בְּרָא־ לִ֣י טָ֭הוֹר לֵ֣ב אֱלֹהִ֑ים חַדֵּ֥שׁ נָ֝כ֗וֹן וְר֥וּחַ בְּקִרְבִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: bə·rā- lî ṭā·hō·wr lêḇ ’ĕ·lō·hîm ḥad·dêš nā·ḵō·wn wə·rū·aḥ bə·qir·bî
verses.literal: Create in me a clean heart O God and renew a right spirit within me

verses.original: תַּשְׁלִיכֵ֥נִי אַל־ מִלְּפָנֶ֑יךָ תִּקַּ֥ח אַל־ קָ֝דְשְׁךָ֗ וְר֥וּחַ מִמֶּֽנִּי׃
verses.transliteration: taš·lî·ḵê·nî ’al- mil·lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā tiq·qaḥ ’al- qāḏ·šə·ḵā wə·rū·aḥ mim·men·nî
verses.literal: Cast me not away . . . from Your presence take not Your Holy Spirit from me

verses.original: הָשִׁ֣יבָה לִּ֭י שְׂשׂ֣וֹן יִשְׁעֶ֑ךָ תִסְמְכֵֽנִי׃ נְדִיבָ֣ה וְר֖וּחַ
verses.transliteration: hā·šî·ḇāh lî śə·śō·wn yiš·‘e·ḵā ṯis·mə·ḵê·nî nə·ḏî·ḇāh wə·rū·aḥ
verses.literal: Restore to me the joy of Your salvation and sustain me with a willing spirit

verses.original: אֲלַמְּדָ֣ה פֹשְׁעִ֣ים דְּרָכֶ֑יךָ וְ֝חַטָּאִ֗ים יָשֽׁוּבוּ׃ אֵלֶ֥יךָ
verses.literal: Then I will teach transgressors Your ways and sinners will return to You

verses.original: הַצִּ֘ילֵ֤נִי מִדָּמִ֨ים׀ אֱ‍ֽלֹהִ֗ים אֱלֹהֵ֥י תְּשׁוּעָתִ֑י לְ֝שׁוֹנִ֗י תְּרַנֵּ֥ן צִדְקָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: haṣ·ṣî·lê·nî mid·dā·mîm ’ĕlō·hîm ’ĕ·lō·hê tə·šū·‘ā·ṯî lə·šō·w·nî tə·ran·nên ṣiḏ·qā·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: Deliver me from bloodguilt O God the God of my salvation and my tongue will sing of Your righteousness

verses.original: אֲ֭דֹנָי תִּפְתָּ֑ח שְׂפָתַ֣י וּ֝פִ֗י יַגִּ֥יד תְּהִלָּתֶֽךָ׃
verses.literal: O Lord open my lips and my mouth will declare Your praise

verses.original: כִּ֤י׀ לֹא־ תַחְפֹּ֣ץ זֶ֣בַח וְאֶתֵּ֑נָה לֹ֣א תִרְצֶֽה׃ ע֝וֹלָ֗ה
verses.transliteration: kî lō- ṯaḥ·pōṣ ze·ḇaḥ wə·’et·tê·nāh lō ṯir·ṣeh ‘ō·w·lāh
verses.literal: For You do not delight in sacrifice or I would bring it vvv You take no pleasure in burnt offerings

verses.original: זִֽבְחֵ֣י אֱלֹהִים֮ נִשְׁבָּ֫רָ֥ה ר֪וּחַ נִשְׁבָּ֥ר וְנִדְכֶּ֑ה לֵב־ אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים לֹ֣א תִבְזֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ziḇ·ḥê ’ĕ·lō·hîm niš·bā·rāh rū·aḥ niš·bār wə·niḏ·keh lêḇ- ’ĕ·lō·hîm lō ṯiḇ·zeh
verses.literal: The sacrifices of God [are] a broken spirit a broken and a contrite heart O God You will not despise

verses.original: בִ֭רְצוֹנְךָ אֶת־ צִיּ֑וֹן הֵיטִ֣יבָה תִּ֝בְנֶ֗ה חוֹמ֥וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ḇir·ṣō·wn·ḵā ’eṯ- ṣî·yō·wn hê·ṭî·ḇāh tiḇ·neh ḥō·w·mō·wṯ yə·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: In Your good pleasure - cause Zion to prosper build up the walls of Jerusalem

verses.original: אָ֤ז תַּחְפֹּ֣ץ צֶ֭דֶק זִבְחֵי־ וְכָלִ֑יל עוֹלָ֣ה אָ֤ז פָרִֽים׃ יַעֲל֖וּ עַל־ מִזְבַּחֲךָ֣
verses.transliteration: ’āz taḥ·pōṣ ṣe·ḏeq ziḇ·ḥê- wə·ḵā·lîl ‘ō·w·lāh ’āz p̄ā·rîm ya·‘ă·lū ‘al- miz·ba·ḥă·ḵā
verses.literal: Then You will delight in righteous sacrifices in whole burnt offerings then bulls will be offered on Your altar
